values: 一名野心勃勃的法师，在战斗中能够使用多种魔法扰乱敌人。
An ambitious Mage who casts a wide range of spells to confound enemies in battle.
让我看看，是谁想当我的对手？
Now, let's see who dares to challenge me.
我的魔法或许已经超越您了，呵呵。
Now, I'd wager my magic has surpassed even yours, heh.
这才是……至高无上的魔法！
Who could possibly stand against me?
魔法存在的意义，就是被人利用
Magic exists to be wielded... and by those with ambition.
我很怀念在莱希拉姆的时光……您呢？
I must admit, I miss those days in the Lyceum... and you?
嗯……啊，您会当作什么都没看见的，对吗？
Hmm... ah, you'll look the other way, won't you?
生活在宫廷里，真是半刻都不能马虎。
Living in the palace... you can never let your guard down.
真是不错的礼物。我们的眼光还是那么一致，梅林。
A marvelous gift. Seems our tastes still align perfectly, Merlin.
啊，该怎么说呢，您的品味一直没变，真好。
Ah, how should I say this? Your taste is as impeccable as ever.
在密布暗纹的长袍下，在无人察觉的阴影中，黑暗的魔力每时每刻都在涌动。
Dark magic lurks everywhere, from within mystical robes to hidden corners.
吾友，我将替你追寻那你不忍读的答案。
My friend, allow me to seek the truth you cannot bear to face.
通过匠业行途活动获得。
宫廷里可不似这般喧嚣
Even the palace doesn't hum with this much energy.
梅林的秘密究竟藏在哪里？
Merlin's secrets... surely they're hidden in plain sight.
The lights and fireworks are blinding!
在莱希拉姆求学时，尽管迪尔格雷非常用功，但他从没拿到过第一名的成绩——因为他与现任梅林同届。

During his time at the Serene Lyceum, Cyran dedicated himself to his studies with unwavering determination. Yet, despite his efforts, the first place always eluded him—mainly because he shared the classroom with the legendary Merlin.
迪尔格雷出身贵族。他的哥哥是当地的英雄骑士，为抵抗魔物而牺牲；他的侄子则是当地的现任领主。

Cyran hails from a distinguished noble family. His brother, a valiant knight, gave his life in the fight against the Hypofiends. Today, his nephew holds the title of lord, continuing the family's noble tradition.
曾经有一位魔法师透露过，迪尔格雷年轻时非常喜欢吃甜食。但最近几年，似乎是因为年纪增长，迪尔格雷的口味发生了一些改变。

A mage once spoke of Cyran's youthful love for sweets, a penchant that seemed to define his early years. But as time passes, his tastes have subtly changed, leaving others to wonder what lies behind this quiet transformation.
迪尔格雷最喜欢的动物是蛇，据说他长袍上的暗纹就是蛰伏在黑暗中的蛇。

The snake, Cyran's favorite animal, is often seen as a symbol of mystery and power. His robe bears a pattern said to mimic a serpent, its form half-hidden in the shadows, a quiet reminder of the secrets he keeps.
尽管已经毕业多年，成为了炙手可热的宫廷魔法师，迪尔格雷依然在暗中研究现任梅林所使用的魔法术式。

Even as a respectable court mage, Cyran harbors a secret: he still studies Merlin's magic, years after his graduation. Some whisper that this obsession with forbidden knowledge may one day cost him more than he realizes.
迪尔格雷重视保养，这使得他看上去比真实年龄年轻不少。

Cyran seems to defy the passage of time, his appearance far younger than his true years. It is said that he tends to his body with the care of one who understands the delicate balance between age and vitality.
迪尔格雷有一条打探消息的特殊渠道，因此在现任梅林苏醒后，他很快就得知了对方失忆的事情。

It was through an informant that Cyran first learned of Merlin's memory loss, which quietly unfolded soon after awakening. The circumstances surrounding this loss remain shrouded in secrecy, raising more questions than answers.
在第二次神魔大战中，无数宫廷魔法师英勇牺牲。在那之后，迪尔格雷成为了地位最高、资历最深的首席宫廷魔法师。

In the wake of the Second Divine War, where many court mages perished, Cyran's vast experience propelled him to the position of chief court mage. His rise was a testament to his resilience and mastery in the arcane arts.
有传闻说，迪尔格雷曾经在宫廷魔法师的遴选中超越了现任梅林。但也有人说，是现任梅林主动放弃了进入宫廷的机会。

There are conflicting accounts regarding the court mage recruitment. Some assert that Cyran outperformed Merlin, securing the position, while others suggest that Merlin opted to forgo the opportunity to serve at the palace to serve a greater purpose.
多年的宫廷生活让迪尔格雷变得喜好奢侈，据说他的书房中收藏有大量镶嵌着魔法宝石的首饰。

After years within the palace walls, Cyran has become accustomed to a life of opulence. His study, a sanctuary of indulgence, is said to hold a vast collection of jewelry, each piece adorned with gemstones imbued with mysterious magic.
哦？你竟然会主动开口询问，看来你真的很关心我们的新晋宫廷魔法师，年轻的科丝蒂小姐。
Oh? You're asking about Cassadee? Now that's interesting. I didn't realize our newest court mage had already won you over.
梅林的著作《实用魔法集录》里居然真的介绍了777种实用的术式……真不愧是最伟大的魔法师！
Merlin's "Compendium of Practical Magic" really does contain 777 spells! Isn't that just proof of why Magister Merlin is the greatest mage to ever live?
宫廷里可不似这般喧嚣
Even the palace doesn't hum with this much energy.
The lights and fireworks are blinding!
迪尔格雷先生，我最近重读《实用魔法集录》时，发现梅林大人曾提过一个有趣的观点——
I was rereading the "Compendium of Practical Magic" and I came across something quite curious that Magister Merlin once wrote.
